cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && POMODORO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/pomo_val QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python - <<'PY' 2>&1
from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
import pomodoro.gui.app as appmod
qa = QApplication([])
from pomodoro.gui.main_window import MainWindow
w = MainWindow(Path('/workspace/sounds'))
w.show()
print("visible:", w.isVisible())
# find tabs
for attr in ('tabs','tab_widget','tabs_widget'):
    if hasattr(w, attr):
        tw = getattr(w, attr)
        print("tab widget attr:", attr, [tw.tabText(i) for i in range(tw.count())])
QTimer.singleShot(2000, qa.quit)
print("exec rc:", qa.exec())
PY
